initialExam.title: Rajasthan Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Rajasthan Police Constable recruitment for General Duty, Driver, and other constable posts in Rajasthan state police force.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, GK & Current Affairs, General Science, Rajasthan GK, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 150 questions, 75 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test. Merit.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Efficiency Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector → DSP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit police.rajasthan.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension, Government quarters
